items.label: Sample room available and representative
items.hint: Walk the sample room yourself; the displayed models must match what is quoted.
items.evidence: Photo of the sample room and model labels

items.label: Workshop layout, 5S and material flow
items.hint: Look for separated dirty and clean zones, WIP racks, and a one-way flow from glass to packing.
items.evidence: Photos of each workshop; sketch of the material flow

items.label: Finished-goods warehouse organised and protected
items.hint: Check stacking height, humidity, and whether finished goods are protected from water and dust.
items.evidence: Photo of the finished-goods area

items.label: Preventive maintenance for key machines
items.hint: Ask for the maintenance log of the tempering furnace and the CNC centres.
items.evidence: Maintenance schedule and the last three months of records

items.label: ISO 9001 certified - copy seen, scope matches
items.hint: Check the certificate number, expiry date, and whether the scope covers shower enclosures and not only trading.
items.evidence: Certificate copy and an IAF CertSearch screenshot

items.label: Incoming inspection for glass, profiles and hardware
items.hint: Ask to see today's incoming records, not a blank template.
items.evidence: IQC records for the last three lots

items.label: In-process and first-article inspection
items.hint: Ask what happens after a tooling change or a new profile.
items.evidence: First-article report and in-process check sheet

items.label: Final inspection to an AQL plan with records
items.hint: Ask for the AQL plan, the sampling level and the last inspection report.
items.evidence: Final inspection report with AQL level

items.label: Measuring and test equipment calibrated
items.hint: Look for calibration labels and certificates on calipers, tape measures and test benches.
items.evidence: Calibration certificates and a photo of the labels

items.label: Batch traceability (marking and records)
items.hint: Pick one finished carton and try to trace the glass batch and the assembly date.
items.evidence: Batch record and carton label

items.label: EN 14428 type-test report for the offered models
items.hint: Ask for the full test report for the exact models offered, not a summary certificate.
items.evidence: Test report: test house, report number, date, model reference

items.label: Tempered glass to EN 12150 with fragmentation records
items.hint: Ask for the EN 12150 report and the fragmentation test record, and confirm the glass supplier.
items.evidence: EN 12150 report, fragmentation record, glass supplier name

items.label: CE marking and Declaration of Performance
items.hint: Check that the manufacturer name on the DoP matches the factory, not a trading company.
items.evidence: DoP document and a photo of the CE label

items.label: Glass thickness, edge quality and hole control
items.hint: Check the thickness range, edge polishing, and that holes are drilled before tempering.
items.evidence: Glass specification and photos of the edge and drilling

items.label: Hardware corrosion resistance (EN 1670 / NSS)
items.hint: Ask for neutral salt spray results on hinges, handles and rollers.
items.evidence: NSS report with hours and rating

items.label: Seals and magnetic strips: material and anti-mould
items.hint: Check the seal material, magnetic strength and anti-mould treatment.
items.evidence: Material data sheet and a photo of the seal cross-section

items.label: REACH and RoHS declarations for plastics and coatings
items.hint: Ask for signed declarations and check the date.
items.evidence: Signed declarations with date

items.label: Water-retention test per batch
items.hint: Ask to see the test on the line and the record for the last batch.
items.evidence: Test bench photo and batch test record

items.label: Test equipment and third-party reports on file
items.hint: List the equipment on site: fragmentation, impact, salt spray, cycle test.
items.evidence: Equipment list with photos and calibration dates

items.label: Packaging specification and drop test
items.hint: Ask for the carton specification and any drop test, and inspect a packed unit.
items.evidence: Packaging spec and drop test report or photo

items.label: OEM / ODM capability
items.hint: Ask whether they can produce under our brand and handle our packaging and labels.
items.evidence: OEM references and a sample label

items.label: Written quotation received
items.hint: Get a written quotation with Incoterm, MOQ, lead time and validity.
items.evidence: Quotation PDF

items.label: Overall impression
items.hint: Your own impression after walking the plant: would you put this factory in front of HQ?
items.evidence: Short note

items.label: Communication and English capability
items.hint: Test English during the visit and identify the future technical contact.
items.evidence: Contact name and role

items.label: Willingness to cooperate and responsiveness
items.hint: Did they open the workshop, share records and answer uncomfortable questions?
items.evidence: Note

tailFields.label: Next steps and follow-up
tailFields.placeholder: e.g. Request EN 14428 report and DoP; second visit after sample approval.

fields.label: Summary and comments
fields.placeholder: Overall impression, open points, what must be verified before the next step (goes to HQ in the PDF).
